ranked_causes.fix: Wait for the region to settle (bounded) before the identity and stability checks instead of failing on the first changing frame; mask a blinking caret; record the codec's refinement interval.
Do not compile an auto-selected row's header text into the next step's postcondition when the row is chosen by a later click.
Accept a re-resolve inside the target's own box (or within the codec's measured jitter, 1-2 px) instead of exact pixel equality.
Bind postcondition regions to the resolved target (offsets from it), not the recorded frame's absolute pixels; or halt at the first step with an explicit 'layout changed' reason.
Exclude run parameters and transient dialog content (duplicate lists) from the recorded identity band.
